name: Deltana
description: A fictional country whose budget is led by nutrition and social programmes, with component gap means drawn far apart: nutrition, animal systems, environment and finance near their benchmarks, markets, post-harvest and research far from them. Every gap is measured, so the divergence is not masked by imputed values. Synthetic demonstration data.
